Breadth and credit remain healthy, volatility is normalizing, and the risk radar's measured 21-day pullback rate is below its base rate, so the evidence does not support originating or escalating a defensive claim. Liquidity is contracting in an orderly, non-stress-confirmed drain. Factor intelligence is immature: only 10 panel dates, no Pair G ledger, no factor-attention history, and no tradeable composite. This memo changes no ranking, sizing, signal, or trade surface.
